title: Account Research Brief
summary: Turn a company name into a structured, one-page research brief before outreach or a first call.
trigger: Before first outreach or a discovery call with a new account.
inputs: Company name and website; optionally the Visma product you're selling.

title: Cold Outreach Email
summary: Write a short, relevant first-touch cold email that earns a reply — not a pitch dump.
trigger: When starting an outbound sequence to a new contact.
inputs: Who you're emailing, what you sell, and one relevant reason for reaching out now.

title: Deal Risk Review
summary: Assess a deal for stall and slippage risk, with reason codes and a recommended intervention.
trigger: During pipeline reviews or before forecasting a deal as commit.
inputs: The deal's stage, dates, activity history, and notes.

title: Discovery Call → SPICED Notes
summary: Turn messy discovery-call notes into a clean, structured SPICED summary for the CRM.
trigger: Right after a discovery or qualification call.
inputs: Your raw notes or transcript from the call.

title: ICP Fit Scoring
summary: Score how well a lead or account matches your Ideal Customer Profile, with a reason for the score.
trigger: When qualifying inbound leads or prioritising an outbound list.
inputs: Your ICP definition and the lead/account details to score.

title: LinkedIn Thought-Leadership Post
summary: Draft a credible, non-salesy LinkedIn post from an idea, insight, or customer story.
trigger: When you want to build presence or share an insight on LinkedIn.
inputs: The core idea or story you want to share and who it's for.

title: Pricing Objection Handling
summary: Get calm, value-anchored responses to "it's too expensive" and other pricing pushback.
trigger: When a prospect raises price or asks for a discount.
inputs: The exact objection, the deal context, and your value points.
